description: Use this when the user asks how power grids compare right now: US operators (PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, MISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE, BPA, TVA), Great Britain, European bidding zones, Taiwan, Japan, South Korea and Brazil, ranked on each feed's latest reading: renewable share, gas share, fuel mix in MW and demand. Freshness differs by feed: read each row's mix_age_hours. No arguments. Full guide: read resource dchub://tool-guides/get_grid_scoreboard
